costSchema.units: Cumulative completed-scope calls and elapsed milliseconds, not process CPU time or GPU execution time. Counters are cumulative; gauges describe the last pump attempt. Exclusive residue in [-1e-6,0) ms is clamped to zero; larger negative durations remain visible and increment timingErrors, as does invalid scope nesting.
costSchema.scope: Development only, disabled by default. Enable before open and reset between measurement epochs outside a running game call. Snapshot does not reset or mutate gameplay. Subtract snapshots with equal epoch. Parent exclusive time retains all uninstrumented work; inclusive phases overlap. Semantic Draw excludes present; submit and texture work may occur inside Draw, present or resource preparation. Frame callback ends before the JS onGameFrame notification; gameTick also covers manually driven live callbacks. Audio mix includes decode/resample/mixing, audioPut includes SDL enqueue, and queueFramesAfterEstimate uses the existing queue observation plus successful 1024-frame puts, with no extra device query. -1 queue gauges mean the last pump did not reach a ready stream. No audio, Draw, input or rollback work is skipped.

scope: Offline context for selecting an early-game scheduler trace window. Existing raw and modern authored sources only; no new run, gate, browser, build or production change.

fieldMapping.cost: Cumulative same-epoch completed-scope counters from the raw costSchema; counter offset=header.length+phases.length*phaseFields.length; phase triples=calls,inclusiveMs,exclusiveMs.

findings: 四份报告每端前900实际输入逐值一致；264..285保持P1=65/P2=1，下一方向边沿286位于停住的前沿之后。
旧诊断两端250..320的textureCreates=104、textureUploads=105、programCompiles=33、musicDecoderOpens=1、sfxDecoderOpens=54、textRender calls=2恒定，没有该范围新加载纹理/程序/文字或decoder的计数证据。
旧P2到前沿283的native为7.905ms；61.47ms的前沿284回调及6块PCM补充发生在rAF恢复之后，不能解释空档起因。
敌人已在214/215被采样观察到，278/287附近各4个；附近效果数变化，但粗采样不能确认首次精灵/效果在283出现。
原P headed-none与B headed-direct通过同一输入区间，没有长gap。不同构建/传输/预测历史使它们不能成为完全受控的GPU状态A/B。
两次不利运行的request年龄分别约5.987秒与4.997/5.015秒。这里只有两次事件，不能据此认定固定帧触发或wall-clock计时器根因。
limitations: 前沿是next-frame/count边界；旧事件的输入283在rAF恢复后才capture，不能把下一tick的工作归给此前等待。
SessionPhase=match不证明内部MatchScene每帧未变化；保留层级差别。
既有atlas新sprite、几何/GL状态首用、异步驱动/GPU工作和浏览器调度仍未排除。这里没有逐draw命令、逐帧像素或内部scene事件记录。
资源计数不增长不等于驱动内部没有延迟编译或首次使用成本。没有使用原EXE、decomp或oracle。
反例采用原harness的rAF时间戳间隔定义，不是物理scanout；与actual request/entry及post-play sample边界不能互相代替。
当前authored source身份与历史raw中的构建/harness身份分别保存，不声称是同一冻结版本。
本证据只支持选择275..290窗口及360帧有界观察；位置重合或一次未复现均不能证明原因或修复。
